lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Highly ordered rows of circular high-luminance spots arranged in a grid-like configuration along the lateral midsection posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs to form a distinctive checkerboard-like geometric pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges running horizontally along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with light intensity on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Moderate distribution of high-luminance blobs localized primarily on the lower half and leading edge of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense cluster of smaller, high-luminance spots on the dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin.
